title: Terminal Flickering and State Reset in iTerm2 on macOS After Plan Approval
body:
**Bug Description**
There's a significant UI glitch in iTerm2 on macOS. This is a more specific issue. After I approve a plan, especially when it seems to involve a Task or Subagent, the entire terminal session starts to flicker erratically. After the flickering stops, the session's state reverts to what it was before the plan was even presented, and I see Claude starting to think about creating a plan all over again.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 1.0.22
- Feedback ID: e9952ec3-67e8-4cad-bf5c-9ff2c55b9b65
author: BobbyWang0120

top_comments.author: CharlonTank
top_comments.body: This is surely related to `claude code` cli becaure many people report this problem on WSL2, or every other terminal that mac has and even Wrap.

top_comments.body: This is making claude code unusable for me. It now makes sense why it seems like claude code keeps "re-planning". This needs to be addressed. Has the anthropic team even acknowledged this issue? I am using wsl2 arch linux.
